citation: Devito et al., Design and Optimization of Electric Traction Motors with Reduced Dependence on Rare Earth Materials
reported_findings: A specific equal-rated 60 kW light-vehicle comparison reports IPM/WFSM/SynRM drive-cycle consumption of 93.70/94.24/94.86 Wh/km, approximately 1.3% spread at the study boundary.
A specific PM-assisted SynRM retrofit study is reported to reduce rare-earth magnet volume by 26% without loss of reported performance.
A hypercar design/FEA comparison is reported to reduce magnet volume by approximately 45% with a small drive-cycle penalty.
A separate heavy-duty long-haul comparison reports a different WFSM/IPM drive-cycle efficiency ranking under its own mission and assumptions.
limitations: Values are from different applications and source studies; not one matched tournament.
Some inverter/system adjustments are calculated under stated assumptions rather than directly measured complete-drive tests.
Magnet volume is not elemental mass; no universal critical-element intensity follows.
Preserve original duty, boundary, evidence class, optimizer and measurement method.
